classes.mechanism: labels an error category based on surface token features such as capitalization, part-of-speech, or term type, rather than determining the semantic role of the changed word in context
classes.check_procedure: Ask whether the source and target tokens differ in their actual referent or only in grammatical modification; if the changed token is an attributive modifier, a general class/rank designation, or a semantically unrelated but valid word, reclassify based on the resulting factual/class meaning, not the token's surface appearance
classes.trigger: question requires classifying a translation or entity error; committed answer picks a category that matches the changed token's surface type (e.g., proper-noun entity, geographical term, taxon-like capitalized term) without checking semantic function

level3.rationale: Uses surface token features (capitalization, POS, term type) to assign an error label instead of the word's semantic role, conflating surface descriptors with the correct semantic category.

classes.mechanism: verifies a geometric classification by checking only one local property, such as perpendicularity, without validating all required structural conditions like opposite-side parallelism and full angle closure
classes.check_procedure: Compare the chosen shape's defining conditions against the full path: verify that every required side relationship and angle condition is independently satisfied, rather than inferred from a single dot product or adjacent edge pair
classes.trigger: question presents a closed SVG path and asks to identify or prove a quadrilateral type; committed answer selects a perpendicular-based shape without demonstrating complete structural verification

level3.rationale: Checks only one local property (perpendicularity) and omits the full set of conditions (parallelism, angle closure) needed for the geometric classification.
